title: Lost Mary Nera15k Banana Ice Prefilled Vape Pods
description: Designed for use with the Lost Mary Nera30K Fullview Prefilled Pod Kit, the Lost Mary Nera15K Prefilled Pods offer a seamless, flavour-packed vaping experience with up to 15,000 puffs per refill pack. Each replacement pod pack includes a 2ml built-in mesh coil pod prefilled with Lost Mary’s signature nic salt e-liquid (20mg), plus an innovative 10ml auto-refilling e-liquid container that keeps your pod topped up for longer-lasting satisfaction. Banana Ice delivers a smooth and creamy Banana flavour with just the right amount of natural sweetness, finished with a crisp and cooling Menthol breeze on the exhale. The result is a perfectly balanced blend that captures the familiar taste of ripe Bananas with a refreshing icy exhale. With easy e-liquid monitoring, a simple push-to-refill system, and premium mesh coil technology, the Lost Mary Nera15K Prefilled Pods ensure consistent, rich flavour and a smooth mouth-to-lung (MTL) vape every time. How to Use: 1. Remove all packaging and protective film. 2. Separate the 2ml prefilled pod and 10ml refill container. 3. Push the refill container into the pod until it clicks securely. 4. Attach the pod to your Nera30K device and remove the silicone plug from the mouthpiece. 5. Vape and enjoy. Once the e-liquid runs out, simply swap in a new Nera15K pod pack from a selection of 20 incredible Lost Mary flavour profiles.
